fieldValues.title: One always-on owner desk: clerk serve keeps the programme current, and the owner judges in rounds
fieldValues.move: clerk serve, a small local service on the owner's machine, keeps the programme's state current without a dev server and carries the owner's judgements through affirmation rounds: start a fresh worktree, act with each judgement shown in its context and weight, publish through the CI gates, merge, finish. The srs-lab control room is its client. Capabilities graduate into the clerk only after real use, CLI first and led by an OpenAPI 3.1 spec.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: A shared or team view: the desk is the owner's own, and local. Badly formed asks from agents, which clerk pr-check holds. Hosting and deployment.
fieldValues.falsifier: After four weeks of use, the owner still goes to GitHub or the terminal to find what waits, or foundational affirmations are made without reasons or in bulk.
fieldValues.return_when: After three real affirmation rounds, or four weeks from the first.
